_comment: Layers the live map can draw on top of itself. Two kinds, and an entry is one or the other.
A DRAWN layer names a shapes file in this folder: polygons, circles, lines and labelled
points, all in world metres. Everything shipped here is drawn, so the page still contains no
map imagery of any kind.
{ "id": "places", "label": "places", "shapes": "places.json" }
A PICTURE layer names an image instead, placed by the world rectangle it covers. Nothing
ships as a picture, but the support is here for your own terrain render or screenshot: drop
the file in this folder and it is offered straight away, stretched across the whole world.
Give it an entry to place it properly.
{ "id": "terrain", "label": "terrain", "file": "terrain.png",
Shared keys:
id       stable key, also how the page remembers this layer's opacity.
label    what the chip in the toolbar says.
world    only offer the layer on this world (see src/world.js for the names). Omit or use
"*" for every world. While the mission has not been read the layer is offered.
bounds   pictures only: [xWest, zSouth, xEast, zNorth] in metres, or "world" for the whole
square. The image's top row is north.
opacity  0 to 1, where the layer starts. The page remembers what you set.
on       true to have the layer enabled the first time someone opens the map.
credit   shown under the map while the layer is on.

overlays.credit: place names approximate to a few hundred metres
